summary: CBAK Energy Technology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of a redomicile merger to reincorporate as a Cayman Islands company. Pursuant to the Merger Agreement dated September 23, 2025, the Nevada corporation merged into its wholly owned Cayman subsidiary, with each share of common stock converted into one ordinary share of the surviving company. The ordinary shares will continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol CBAT. No premium, price, or advisor was disclosed because this is a jurisdictional migration, not a transformative M&A event. Watch for potential tax implications or future corporate actions under Cayman law.
